notes.title: Forgotlings launches on June 12—Enjoy the brand new release date trailer!
notes.content:
[h1]Release date announcement 📢 [/h1]
It's official: Forgotlings launches on June 12!

Mark your calendars 🗓️ make sure you've wishlisted on Steam 🎮 and enjoy the brand new Forgotlings release date trailer below 🎬✨

[previewyoutube=wfjXWA5QW78;full][/previewyoutube]
And that’s not all—we want as many of you as possible to experience the first game in our franchise, Forgotton Anne. Stay tuned, as we’ll soon be announcing massive discounts! 🚀

[h2]Forgotlings Release Date Revealed – The Next Chapter in the Forgotten Lands Arrives on June 12th 2025[/h2]
[h3]New Trailer Showcases Stunning Hand-Drawn Adventure from the Creators of Forgotton Anne[/h3]

After five years in the making and a successful Kickstarter campaign, the highly-anticipated sequel to Forgotton Anne is nearly here. Throughline Games has officially revealed that Forgotlings will launch on the 12th of June for Steam, and is expected shortly after on other platforms. To celebrate, a brand-new Release Date Trailer has been unveiled today, giving players a deeper look at the game’s breathtaking world & cinematic 2D handcrafted storytelling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/caad2a89f463b04740c511461bec20153d41a0ac.png[/img]
Fans of emotionally driven, story-rich games who have yet to experience the unique universe of Forgotton Anne should consider taking advantage of upcoming discounts on the title — an ideal way to experience the world before Forgotlings arrives.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/65f033a3ab0c4611dfc455c9d681d43fa2b87cf2.png[/img]

[h2]A New Standalone Adventure in the World of the Forgotten[/h2]

In Forgotlings, players take on the role of Fig, a charismatic posing doll navigating a fractured world to unite five forgotling tribes. Forgotlings are sentient lost objects longing to rediscover their purpose as a Beast threatens to destroy the Forgotten Lands. As he explores lush forgotten landscapes, battles enigmatic foes, and uncovers ancient secrets, Fig must determine his place in a world where memories are power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/431ffacf93f20faa98b9959ec44dccf418a07c2c.png[/img]
With stunning hand-drawn visuals, a haunting score featuring renowned choir ensemble Theatre of Voices, a deep narrative with choice mechanics, and an expansive, action-packed world, Forgotlings builds upon its predecessor’s beloved storytelling while offering an entirely new, standalone experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/cab1dbbfe2ea60fba0b76cab3630d09aec2ebba6.png[/img]
"In a world increasingly divided, Forgotlings invites players to escape into the Forgotten Lands—where their choices shape the fate of a fractured society. This is a story of belonging, of tribal factions at odds, and of finding purpose in a time of uncertainty.” says Alfred Nguyen, Creative Director at Throughline Games. “While we didn’t set out to make a timely allegory, the themes of Forgotlings resonate now more than ever."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/19c6ed6d5ca874ba1b0c167cc02377dcac341f3f.png[/img]

[h2]Wishlist Forgotlings Now – And Watch the New Trailer![/h2]
Forgotlings is now available for wishlisting on Steam, and players eager to experience the original world should stay tuned for upcoming news of Forgotton Anne’s Steam Spring Sale participation.
📺 Watch the Release Date Trailer here: https://youtu.be/wfjXWA5QW78
🛒 Wishlist Forgotlings on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2059570/Forgotlings/
To learn more, visit the [url=http://www.forgotlings.com/]game’s[/url] and [url=http://www.throughlinegames.com]ThroughLine Games’[/url] official websites, [url=https://discord.gg/REHa6mKHTV]Discord Server[/url], like the studio’s [url=http://facebook.com/throughlinegames]Facebook page[/url], and follow [url=http://twitter.com/throughlinegame]@ThroughLineGame[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/Hitcents]@Hitcents[/url] on Twitter.

You can buy [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/542050/Forgotton_Anne/]Forgotton Anne[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066640/Forgotton_Anne_Soundtrack/?snr=1_5_9__405]Forgotton Anne Soundtrack[/url] or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/630420/Forgotton_Anne_Collectors_Upgrade/?snr=1_5_9__405]Forgotton Anne Collectors Upgrade[/url] at 70% off!

You'll also meet Fig — the agile posing doll who is the protagonist of Forgotlings and a major character in Forgotton Anne:

Wishing you and your loved ones a wonderful festive season and a Happy New Year, from all of us here at Throughline Games!

Read on for a quick refresher about Forgotton Anne.

[h1]Forgotton Anne[/h1]

Step into a hand-animated realm of wonder...

Imagine a place where everything that is lost and forgotten goes; old toys, letters, single socks. The Forgotten Lands is a magical world inhabited by Forgotlings; creatures composed of mislaid objects longing to be remembered again.

Forgotton Anne is a seamless cinematic adventure game with light puzzle platforming elements. You play as Anne, the enforcer who keeps order in the Forgotten Lands, as she sets out to quash a rebellion that might prevent her master, Bonku, and herself from returning to the human world...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/90b81bea141a3386087ff5a193bab0d874bff0b9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/a5dfaccce18642c25de4c08ff2f0ecfcd06d8785.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/12c695a705840478a9d407d5ae637a756050425e.png[/img]

[h1]About Forgotlings and Forgotton Anne[/h1]

Forgotlings and Forgotton Anne are part of the same series, continuing our tradition of lovingly-crafted hand-animated games with a focus on cinematic storytelling. Forgotlings is the direct prequel to our debut award-winning title Forgotton Anne.

Visit the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/542050/Forgotton_Anne/]Steam page for Forgotton Anne[/url] now to get the 70% discount for yourself or for a friend.

Limited sale runs from December 19, 2024 to January 2, 2025.

notes.title: All Aboard The Forgotlings Steam Reveal!
notes.content:
[h1]Prepare to embark on an unforgettable adventure[/h1] in the enchanting world of Forgotlings, brought to you by the talented developers of Forgotten Anne. Coming to PlayStation 4|5, Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and PC via Steam in 2024, this breathtaking cinematic action adventure will transport you to a realm filled with forgotten objects and familiar characters! :rocket: 

Join Fig, the gifted posing doll, on an epic quest to unite different tribes of forgotlings against a menacing beast threatening to plunge the world into darkness. As the captain of The Volare, Fig's ship and base of operations, you'll lead a crew of forgotlings in exhilarating combat, blending hack-and-slash with strategy and stealth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/be299716dae0f0f972faafc9aa13d7ffc2429039.png[/img]

[h2]Delve into a mesmerizing 2.5D semi open-world[/h2] metroidvania, exploring hidden ancient secrets in the desert Dunes, scaling the majestic Agora Mountains, and beyond. Engage in interactive conversations, forge relationships, and shape the destiny of tribes through alliances you form along the way.

Challenge fellow forgotlings to the popular board game INA, unlocking intriguing dialogues and strengthening connections. Customize your INA decks with powerful Power Stones and test your skills against rivals. Can you ascend the ranks and claim the title of Grandmaster?
Prepare to be captivated by the thousands of meticulously hand-drawn animation frames, full voice acting, and an awe-inspiring score featuring Theatre of Voices. Immerse yourself in a world where imagination and emotion intertwine.

[h3]Mark your calendars![/h3] Forgotlings is set to launch on PlayStation 4|5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, and PC via Steam in 2024. Don't miss out on rediscovering the power of forgotten things and embracing the diverse wonders of a world beyond our own! :milky_way:
